messages:
tyler: heads up — customer reported a Viewer was able to change project logging exports via the Console UI. can repro on staging.

maria: oh wow. which customer / steps?

tyler: steps: go to Projects > MyProject > Settings > Logging, click Edit, change export destination, Save. viewer account was able to save. repro with test-viewer@staging.redwood.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-4321 (sev2) — assigned to eng-security oncall.

ana: (typo) ana: checking audit logs now, pulling events for project:myproject. any KMS rotations recently?

kevin: audit shows UI event `role_change` and `project_update` at ~2026-11-03T14:12Z with actor id viewer-uid-7f3. payload includes `updated_fields: ["logging.export_destination"]`.

maria: that actor string should never be allowed to perform `project_update`. this smells like the scope/role split we merged last sprint where we introduced project-scoped role aliases. maybe alias resolution mapping bug.

devx: I can look at the UI gating code — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1428 (the role-scope split). I added client-side gating but maybe server-side check omitted for legacy routes.

tyler: mitigation: revoke `project_edit` mapping for role `viewer` in RBAC service for staging and prod immediately. also add a server-side guard that blocks `project_update` unless token has explicit `project:edit` scope.

ana: KMS rotation: we rotated key rk-04 on 2026-10-30. audit shows no key usage anomalies tied to this event. not related to KMS.

kevin: confirming: this is an authorization mapping bug, not authN or KMS. audit trail looks clean — helpful for customer communication.

maria: proposed fix: 1) patch RBAC policy resolver to prefer explicit scoped permissions over legacy aliases 2) add unit + e2e test for viewer->project update negative case 3) ship canary and monitor audit spikes.

devx: pushed small server-side check to gate legacy endpoints: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/commit/3a7f9c2 — canary build ready on staging.

sam: add an integration test in infra/e2e/permissions that tries viewer->project:update and asserts 403. I can take that.

tyler: customer-facing note: Tentative root cause = role-scope alias mapping regression caused viewer to inherit project_edit on certain UI routes. remediation in progress; will notify once fix is deployed to canary.

kevin: also adding an audit alert rule: `role_change` or `project_update` events originating from roles in viewer-group should trigger an ops PagerDuty if > 1 unexpected event in 5m.

maria: after canary looks good we should backfill a data migration to re-calculate role bindings for all projects to ensure no lingering aliases.

tyler: P0 created: ENGSEC-550. assigning owners: maria (fix), devx (server gating), sam (tests), kevin (audit rules), ana (customer comms).

sre-bot: Update: INC-4321 status -> investigating.

maria: quick note — please don't mention KMS in customer outbound; call it an RBAC policy regression. saves confusion.

tyler: agreed. i'll draft the support update.

kevin: once fixed, let's also add a lightweight alert that watches for `policy_eval` mismatches between client and server for new role-scope paths.

sam: I'll queue the e2e test + test matrix in CI. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

ana: thanks all — will monitor logs and confirm when alerts trigger or the canary blocks the action.

tyler: closing loop: will post follow-up thread with rollout timestamps and customer note once done.
